mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-month rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting market anticipation of weakened labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross above 6% in the next 20 trading days, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and the CPI inflation index signals conflicting policy signals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates and reduced growth.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 60-day window, or 60-day forward returns are not consistently negative despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly GDP growth rate above historical trend in the demand domain predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as stronger economic activity boosts corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: GDP growth does not exceed historical trend in the next 20 trading days, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the INDPRO supply index below 90 triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting reduced production capacity and potential supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not fall below 90 in the next 5 trading days, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A convergence of rising employment numbers (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment rates (UNRATE) creates a labor market tightening signal, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as confidence in growth strengthens.
failure_condition: The interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 20-day window, or 20-day forward returns are not consistently positive despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening monetary cycle, sustained high federal funds rates above 4.5% predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate investment and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not remain above 4.5% in the next 60 trading days, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in household demand measured by HOUST above 650 units triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting increased consumer spending and corporate optimism.
failure_condition: HOUST does not exceed 650 in the next 5 trading days, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
